archetype: Melee STR warrior built around a Morph Gauge and a Final Form transformation. Gauge-driven sustained DPM rather than a burst class: consistent chip damage, very strong mobility via its transformed teleport, good self-survivability, and effectively no party utility. Damage output depends on weaving and resetting cooldowns to keep the gauge and Final Form up.

linkSkill.effect: Grants Max HP and, on Kaiser itself, additional damage that scales with Morph Gauge Stage. The wiki entry states that only the Max HP portion carries over when the skill is taken as a Link Skill on another character. See conflicts - sources disagree on whether the damage component transfers.

vMatrix.notes: The V Matrix system itself was reworked and the class guide's V Matrix section was rewritten for it on 2026-06-17, so any Kaiser node advice written before mid-2026 describes a different system. Two pieces of process advice from the class guide: level skills within a tier at roughly the same rate instead of maxing them one at a time (unless you are swimming in nodestones), and try to have everything in Tiers 1-3 maxed before you unlock 6th job. Grandis Library's boost node page has a separate 'Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' view, confirming the groupings changed at v.269. Source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12iH3vqAQCelM7QC2Kgm4qYQE4nUttGEKh2_r5k7R5Vw/ and https://www.grandislibrary.com/nova/kaiser

hexa.notes: NOT RECORDED ON PURPOSE. The Heroic Kaiser guide does publish a 'HEXA Matrix Priority' section, but it exists only as an embedded infographic image with no text equivalent, and no other current source gives a Kaiser-specific HEXA investment order. Inventing one would be worse than leaving it blank. What IS sourced: (1) Mastery nodes are gated by V Matrix boost node levels - HEXA Gigas Wave needs Boost Node 1 at 40+, HEXA Blade Burst and HEXA Tempest Blades need Boost Node 2 at 40+, HEXA Inferno Breath needs Boost Node 3 at 40+, HEXA Wing Beat and HEXA Stone Dragon need Boost Node 4 at 40+, and HEXA Might of the Nova needs the Might of the Nova skill node at 25+. HEXA Blade Burst, HEXA Tempest Blades, HEXA Wing Beat and HEXA Stone Dragon share mastery node slots with each other, so you cannot run all of them. (2) Rotation share: the Origin skill Nova Triumphant is roughly 4% of a full rotation and the common node skill Sol Hecate roughly 7%. (3) Nova Triumphant gains +20% IED at level 10, +20% boss damage at level 20 and +30% IED plus +30% boss damage at level 30 (total +50% IED, +50% boss). (4) The Ascent skill Pyroclastic Instinct gains +10% IED and +10% boss at level 10, the same again at level 20, and +20% IED at level 30 (total +40% IED, +20% boss); it stacks with the passive IED for 100% IED. (5) Sol Hecate gains +20% IED and +20% boss at level 10 and again at level 20 (total +40%/+40%), with Charon unlocking at 20 and Phlegethon at 30. (6) Sol Janus is the explicit exception to any priority: the guide says how far you level it depends entirely on how much you grind, at any point in your HEXA progression, and suggests only unlocking it at level 1 initially. Below level 10 the Dusk form is generally better; at 10+ the Dawn rings become stronger. Source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12iH3vqAQCelM7QC2Kgm4qYQE4nUttGEKh2_r5k7R5Vw/ (updated 2026-09-09). Note on patch currency: that update entry discusses the 9/9 patch directly, stating that Nova Triumphant's per-line damage was reduced but its damage inside the transformation window is unchanged or slightly higher because of a new +20% final damage condition, and explicitly calls this not a nerf.

hyperStats.notes: No Kaiser-specific hyper stat priority could be sourced. The Heroic Kaiser guide has no hyper stat section, Grandis Library does not list one, and the only Kaiser pages that discuss 'hyper stats' (AyumiLove, DigitalTQ) are talking about AP distribution, not the hyper stat window, and are from 2024. One genuinely Kaiser-specific and current fact that bears on the decision: the guide enumerates Kaiser's critical rate sources as base 5%, Attacker Mode III 20%, Catalyze 20%, Expert Sword Mastery 20%, Decent Sharp Eyes 10%, Focus Spirit Lv3 10%, Night Lord legion 4-5%, Marksman legion 4-5%, and legion artifact 20% - summing to well over 100% before any hyper stat is spent. Grandis Library independently lists Kaiser's permanent crit rate from skills alone as +65%. Treat 'Kaiser therefore does not need Crit Rate hyper stat' as a reasonable inference from those numbers, not as a sourced recommendation. Sources: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12iH3vqAQCelM7QC2Kgm4qYQE4nUttGEKh2_r5k7R5Vw/ and https://www.grandislibrary.com/nova/kaiser

hyperSkills.notes: No current source gives a ranked pick order for the active hyper skills. Kaiser's Majesty is documented in detail and is the one active with real rotation weight: it halves the cooldown of all 4th job and lower skills for 30 seconds (with two excluded skills), and the reduction applies both to skills cast during its window and to cooldowns already ticking when it is pressed. The guide's stated purpose for it is to squeeze in extra casts of two short-cooldown skills during burst and to guarantee uptime on a third. The -50% is applied after other cooldown reduction such as a cooldown hat and Mercedes legion. Source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12iH3vqAQCelM7QC2Kgm4qYQE4nUttGEKh2_r5k7R5Vw/

innerAbility.consensus: weak - published on Grandis Library, which credits the Heroic Kaiser guide for its inner ability build; the guide's own inner ability section is an infographic image. Effectively one source.
innerAbility.notes: Attack Speed +1 is explicitly NO LONGER recommended as of the current guide: Kaiser reaches attack speed level 9 without it (two-handed swords start at 4, then Blaze On +2, Sword Mastery +1, Decent Speed Infusion +1, Extreme Green Potion +1), and the guide states there is zero practical difference between attack speed levels 9 and 10 in the current build. This directly contradicts older guides that list Attack Speed +1 as the top Kaiser line - see conflicts. Buff duration is worth chasing generally: the guide values 40% buff duration at roughly 3% final damage over a full rotation, with other buff duration coming from Mechanic legion (20-25%), the Guiding Stars link (19%), traits (10%), legion artifact (20%) and the legion board (up to 40%).

gearingNotes: Two-handed sword relative power, weakest to strongest, per the current class guide: Sweetwater Two-Handed Sword, Fafnir Penitent Tears, AbsoLab Broad Saber, Ryude's Sword, Liberated Kaiserium, Arcane Umbra Two-Handed Sword, Genesis Two-Handed Sword, Destiny Two-Handed Sword. That is a strength ranking, not an upgrade path - the recommended actual progression is Fafnir into AbsoLab into Arcane Umbra into Genesis into Destiny. An early Kaiserium is only worth using if you do not expect to reach Arcanes soon. Secondary: buy the Evolving Secondary Weapon Selection Box from the secondary weapon vendor and take the Evolving Nova Truth Essence (+10 all stats, +2 attack); its potential transfers into the Astra Nova Essence once you unlock stage 1. Astra Nova Essence is the true BiS, enhanced in three stages for +10/15/20 all stats and +7 attack, star-forceable to 15/20/30 stars. Oz rings, valued at endgame gear levels as of 2026-09-09: Ring of Restraint 4 gives roughly 27.7% final damage during its 15 second window on a 120 second cooldown, working out to roughly 7.9% final damage overall; Continuous Ring 4 gives roughly 7.4% final damage at full uptime. Both can be equipped and used at once. Grindstone upgrading favours Ring of Restraint at both level 5 and level 6. Cooldown hat ranking: 33% STR is worst, then 36% STR tied with a plain -4s cooldown line, then -4s cooldown plus all stat or STR, then -5s or -6s cooldown (described as unrealistic on Heroic servers). The guide advises against actively chasing a cooldown hat early - keep a 3-line STR% CRA hat and revisit it when Eternals start appearing. WSE target is 3-line attack% on weapon, secondary and emblem, but the guide's advice is to keep the first acceptable roll because minmaxing WSE is very expensive relative to other upgrades. Legion board ordering: critical damage, then boss damage, then buff duration and IED, then STR, then attack. On pitched swapping, the guide's position is that you can swap a decently flamed 22-star 3-line Gollux belt and earring for a Dreamy Belt and Commanding Force Earrings once you have both completed, and recommends moving to a transposed Sweetwater Pendant or a Daybreak Pendant when you leave Gollux - with the caveat that the maths assumes the older 22-star starforce meta and is muddier under current starforce, so check against a scouter. Source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12iH3vqAQCelM7QC2Kgm4qYQE4nUttGEKh2_r5k7R5Vw/ (updated 2026-09-09).

commonMistakes.mistake: Locking Dragonflare in the V Matrix.
commonMistakes.why: A locked Dragonflare stops the automatic fire orbs from spawning, which the guide puts at roughly 2-3% final damage. It says outright not to lock this skill.

commonMistakes.mistake: Pressing the Dragonflare key again during burst.
commonMistakes.why: A second press deactivates the flare, cancelling the buff window you just opened.

commonMistakes.mistake: Maxing V Matrix nodes one at a time.
commonMistakes.why: The guide recommends raising everything inside a tier at roughly an even rate, and only maxing individually if you have surplus nodestones.

commonMistakes.mistake: Casting Wing Beat too early in the rotation.
commonMistakes.why: Wing Beat should be held until higher-value skills such as Gigas Wave and Inferno Breath / Tempest Blades are on cooldown; used out of order it displaces stronger casts.

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-casting Tempest Blades before Dragon Blow has triggered.
commonMistakes.why: Two Tempest Blades casts are needed to arm Dragon Blow; casting again before it fires wastes the cast. The mark itself does not expire, so there is no rush.

commonMistakes.mistake: Stacking Nova Guardians and Dragonflare on the same timing while mobbing.
commonMistakes.why: Both are large-area, long-duration sources of mobbing damage; the guide recommends staggering them to keep mobbing coverage continuous.

commonMistakes.mistake: Squeezing in an extra cast of a cooldown-skipped DPM skill in the ~30 seconds before your next burst.
commonMistakes.why: If a skill's cooldown gets skipped late in the cycle, taking the free fourth cast risks the skill not being available when the burst window opens, which breaks the whole burst timing. (The guide names the specific skill via an icon that could not be read from the text version, so it is left unnamed here rather than guessed.)

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating Kaiser as a burst class.
commonMistakes.why: The guide lists relatively low burst and one of the lowest culvert scores in the game as Kaiser's drawbacks; its value is sustained damage and uptime, not burst windows.

conflicts.topic: Iron Will link skill - does the damage component transfer?
conflicts.positionA: maplestorywiki.net states Iron Will grants Max HP +5% (Lv1) to +15% (Lv3) plus damage per Morph Gauge Stage of +2% (Lv1) to +4% (Lv3), and says explicitly that only the HP increase applies when the skill is used as a Link Skill. Source: https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Kaiser/Skills (edited 2026-08-11)
conflicts.positionB: Grandis Library's Kaiser base-stat table lists the Lv3 link skill under Damage, at +3%/+4% per Morph Gauge Stage for a maximum of +9% at Lv2 and +12% at Lv3 - i.e. treating the damage as active on the Kaiser itself. Source: https://www.grandislibrary.com/nova/kaiser
conflicts.positionC: Older independent guides give only a flat HP figure and disagree on the number: AyumiLove (2024-10-16) says +10/15/20% Max HP, DigitalTQ (2024-02-19) says +15% Max HP.
conflicts.notResolved: Both current sources agree on +15% Max HP at Lv3. Whether the Morph Gauge damage rider applies to a non-Kaiser holder of the link is unresolved here; the wiki's wording says it does not, Grandis Library's table implies it does at least for the Kaiser. The 2024 HP numbers differ from the 2026 ones and should be treated as stale.

conflicts.topic: Attack Speed +1 as an inner ability line
conflicts.positionA: Official Heroic Kaiser Guide (2026-09-09): attack speed is no longer recommended on inner ability, because Kaiser reaches attack speed level 9 from Blaze On, Sword Mastery, Decent Speed Infusion and Extreme Green Potion, and there is no practical difference between levels 9 and 10 in the current build.
conflicts.positionB: AyumiLove (2024-10-16) and DigitalTQ (2024-02-19) both list Attack Speed +1 as Kaiser's top inner ability line.
conflicts.notResolved: Recorded rather than resolved, though the recency gap is large and the 2026 position gives a mechanical reason. Anyone rerolling inner ability today should weigh the 2026 source more heavily.

conflicts.positionA: Current groupings (Grandis Library at v.269 and later, and the class guide): Node 1 Gigas Wave + Draco Surge / Dragon Slash; Node 2 Blade Burst / Tempest Blades; Node 3 Inferno Breath; Node 4 Stone Dragon / Wing Beat / Pressure Chain; Node 5 Flame Surge / Impact Wave / Piercing Blaze; Node 6 Dragon Barrage / Ancestral Prominence.
conflicts.positionB: 2024 guides describe different trios, e.g. Blade Burst / Gigas Wave / Tempest Blades and Wing Beat / Inferno Breath, and reference a 'Dragon Blaze' node.
conflicts.notResolved: Not a genuine disagreement so much as a system change: the class guide's update log records a V Matrix rework on 2026-06-17 and Grandis Library keeps a separate 'Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' view. The 2024 groupings should be treated as obsolete, not as a competing opinion.

conflicts.topic: Independence of the current-patch build advice
conflicts.positionA: There are three or more independent sources for Kaiser's class facts (Heroic Kaiser Guide, maplestorywiki.net, AyumiLove, DigitalTQ, plus Grandis Library for stat tables).
conflicts.positionB: For the judgement layer - V Matrix levelling order, hyper passive build, inner ability - there is effectively ONE current source. Grandis Library's credits line attributes exactly those sections to the Heroic Kaiser Guide, so the apparent agreement between the two is not independent corroboration. The only other Kaiser-specific build opinions found are from 2024 and predate the V Matrix rework.
conflicts.notResolved: Stated rather than resolved. This is why consensusLevel is 'moderate' and most individual claims are marked 'weak'.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: FABRICATED SOURCE DATE. sources[0].dated reads '2026-09-09 (update log entry covering the 9/9 patch; prior entry 2026-06-17 for the V Matrix rework and Erel Light link)'. I fetched the guide three times (docs.google.com/document/d/12iH3vqAQCelM7QC2Kgm4qYQE4nUttGEKh2_r5k7R5Vw/mobilebasic) and asked directly for its update history. It has a SINGLE dated entry, 'Updated: 2026-09-09'. There is no multi-entry change log, no 2026-06-17 entry, and no mention of a V Matrix rework anywhere in it. 'Erel Light' does appear in the document, but in an entirely different context - as part of the link-skill line 'Guiding Stars (Sia Astelle/Erel Light)'. This reads like a real detail relocated into an invented changelog entry. It is load-bearing: vMatrix.notes uses the 2026-06-17 date to date-stamp the whole rework argument.

MISATTRIBUTED NODE RATINGS - the file puts words in Grandis Library's mouth and inverts its actual advice. vMatrix.trios rates Boost Node 3 (Inferno Breath) and Boost Node 4 (Stone Dragon/Wing Beat/Pressure Chain) as 'Primary - unlocks a 6th job HEXA mastery', citing grandislibrary.com/nova/kaiser. Grandis Library's Boost Node Legend actually rates: PRIMARY = Nodes 1 and 2 only; SECONDARY = Node 3, defined as nodes that 'don't unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery but are still used'; OTHER = Nodes 4, 5 and 6, 'do not need to be upgraded or has least priority'. So the file (a) asserts a rating the cited source does not give, (b) for Node 3 asserts the exact opposite of what that source says about HEXA mastery unlocking, and (c) rates Node 4 'Primary' where the source rates it lowest priority. The file's node-5/node-6 'Other' ratings are correct.

UNRECORDED CONFLICT arising from the above. The Heroic Kaiser Guide states 'Requirement: Inferno Breath Boost Node Level 40+' for HEXA Inferno Breath, and requirements on Wing Beat/Pressure Chain and Stone Dragon/Pressure Chain for HEXA Wing Beat and HEXA Stone Dragon. Grandis Library says Node 3 unlocks no HEXA mastery and Node 4 is lowest priority. That is a genuine head-on disagreement between the two cited sources about whether Nodes 3 and 4 gate HEXA masteries, and the file's conflicts[] array does not record it - it silently resolves in favour of the guide while citing Grandis Library as agreeing.

UNVERIFIED IN SOURCE (not proven invented, flagged because I could not find it): (a) 'the common node skill Sol Hecate roughly 7%' of rotation - the guide does state '~4% of our full rotation' for Nova Triumphant, which I confirmed, but no Sol Hecate percentage appears; (b) 'HEXA Might of the Nova requires the Might of the Nova skill node at level 25 or higher' - six boost-node 40+ requirements are stated in the guide, none for Might of the Nova; (c) the entire cooldown hat ranking in gearingNotes (33% STR worst, then 36% STR tied with -4s, then -4s + all stat/STR, then -5s/-6s) - the guide mentions '-4s CD hat' only as a technical aside under Kaiser's Majesty and carries no hat ranking in what I could retrieve. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the fetch of the doc is truncated (it cuts off mid-sentence inside the Sol Hecate section), so any of these three could live in the unretrieved tail. They should be re-verified against the full document before publication, not assumed good.

MINOR / UNCONFIRMED: conflicts[2] positionB says the 2024 guides 'reference a Dragon Blaze node'. Neither AyumiLove nor DigitalTQ mentions a Dragon Blaze node in what I retrieved. AyumiLove's trios are Gigas Wave/Wingbeat/Tempest Blades and Infernal Breath/Stone Dragon/Blade Burst; DigitalTQ's are Blade Burst/Gigas Wave/Tempest Blades and Wing Beat/Inferno Breath/[Free].
